content.title: Harnessing a high-quality Salmonella genome catalog to combat antimicrobial resistance and inform outbreak responses.
content.abstract: •A century-scale analysis of 208,000 + Salmonella genomes reveals accelerating global antimicrobial resistance (AMR).•Multidrug-resistant Salmonella outbreaks are rising worldwide, endangering food safety and public health systems.•Fluoroquinolone- and cephalosporin-resistant Salmonella are WHO-prioritized threats, demanding genomic surveillance.•CLSGDBv2 enables open-access, One Health monitoring of Salmonella AMR evolution and dissemination.•Environmental, social, and climatic drivers shape Salmonella AMR emergence, informing targeted interventions.
